title: Rama Nand v. State of Himachal Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Rama Nand v. State of Himachal Pradesh, (1981) 1 SCC 511
content.holding: Held that recovery of the dead body (corpus delicti) is not an absolute condition precedent for conviction of culpable homicide or murder; guilt can be established by cogent, clinching circumstantial evidence pointing unmistakably to death.
content.relevance: Primary authority for proving culpable homicide in missing-body and destroyed-corpse prosecutions.
